image.name: darktable
image.description: [darktable](https://www.darktable.org/) is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers. It manages your digital negatives in a database, lets you view them through a zoomable lighttable and enables you to develop raw images and enhance them.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Rebase to Arch as Alpine not longer offers aarch64.
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and images

ports.desc: Darktable desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

image.title: Darktable
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  darktable:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/darktable:latest
    container_name: darktable
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=darktable \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/darktable:latest
